title: Vlorë — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Vlorë: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Vlorë has a population of 79,000. A coastal city in southwestern Albania on the Adriatic and Ionian Seas, known for its beautiful beaches, the Independence Monument, and the Karaburun Peninsula. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
